name: Codimension-One Staircase q-Cap Contraction Obstructions
definition: Let $X=\{a,b,c,z,q\}\mathbin{\dot\cup}W$ and $U=W\mathbin{\dot\cup}\{z\}$. Delete $\{a\}$, $\{b\}$, $\{a,b\}$, $\{a,c\}$, the anchored subcube $\{\{a,b,c\}\cup T:T\subseteq U\}$, and its codimension-one q-cap $\{\{a,b,c,q\}\cup S:S\subseteq W\}$. The base is the complement $\mathcal K_d^{\mathrm{st},\mathrm{qcap}}$ in $2^X$; attach a new pendant coordinate $f$ at the empty endpoint.
canonical_form: The coordinate $z$ distinguishes the codimension-one face $W$ of the anchored support $U$, and $q$ carries the added cap.
recognition: A construction certificate verifies the valid root $\{b,c\}$, the exact rooted-union holes at $\varnothing$ and $X$, and their repair sets $\{a,b,c\}$ and $U\cup\{q\}$.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. No pc-minimality or completeness claim is made because learning-space graphs are not closed under convex restrictions.
